heading: Tree layout
text:
## Tree layout [ITST.2]

```
runtime/
  libds.build                  Builds libds.a and both suites:
                               an ImplTest and a SpecTest table,
                               one row per test binary.
  tests/
    libds/
      impl/
        test_<area>_<scenario>.c   May include internal headers.
      spec/
        spec_common.h          Public-API-only convenience macros.
        test_<area>_spec.c         libds.h and spec_common.h only.
      source/
        test_*.py              Scans over libds's sources and the
                               suites, run before the impl suite.
```
